notes: Commercial low-pile loop broadloom for the play area -- the floor a folding table and eight chairs stand on (walker, 2026-09-15, card-shop references). DRAB ON PURPOSE, and that is the whole difference from the other two carpets: carpet_delco is the walker's burgundy at chroma_mean 0.064, carpet_club_delco is a burgundy-and-teal medallion figure at 0.043, and both are a room's subject. This one is a stage for a pack wall and a table of cards, so it is a grey-green under the 0.030 environment budget with no figure at all, a flatter response (roughness 0.96 +- 0.03 against 0.95 +- 0.04) and a single broad soil pass instead of the club's three trodden and spilled ones. THE LOOP IS NOT DRAWN. A 1/10 in gauge is 2.54 mm, which at the pack's 128 px/m is 0.33 of a texel -- below the grid, so `weave` would draw a hard per-texel alternation and not a loop (Pixelcoat 0.43.0 measured exactly that on linen: 64 threads on a 128 px tile read ac1 0.15). The pile is carried by the micro band and the grain instead.
